name: clawd-hq
description: A virtual office side panel: Clawd runs the floor, every subagent is an employee at a desk

chiefOfStaff.title: Clawd runs the chat
chiefOfStaff.description: On (default): the main chat works as Clawd, the chief of staff. He hands real work to specialists, asks you only what needs you, and reports in plain words. Off: Claude behaves as usual and you keep the panel.

voiceFile.title: Your own voice file
voiceFile.description: The full path of a text file that sets how Clawd sounds, in place of his built-in voice. It changes his tone only, never his rules. Leave empty for the built-in voice. Read when a session starts, up to 8000 characters.

recap.title: Recap on Clawd's card
recap.description: On (default): after at least three turns and three quiet minutes, Clawd's card shows one line on where things stand, the way Claude Code's own session recap does. It asks the model one short question about the session, which uses a little of your plan. Off: no recap is made.

quietChat.title: Quiet chat
quietChat.description: On (default): while Clawd runs the chat, it hides the 'finished' notices of specialists he hired, the messages of teammates he hired by name, and his own no-update lines. He reports once the job is done, and the Log tab lists what finished. A failure or a request (a question, permission, approval) always shows, and the full view (ctrl+o) shows everything. Off: the chat shows every row as Claude Code draws it.

youShouldKnow.title: You should know
youShouldKnow.description: On (default): after each specialist hands its work back, a small model reads its steps and its report and may leave one short note on Clawd's card when something matters, such as a claim no step backs up or a test that failed. It uses a little of your plan. While it is on, Claude Code's own "You should know" note above the prompt box stays quiet. Off: no checks are made, and Claude Code's own note works as usual.
